coverageRule: Schedule presence is not Deep Dive completion. A game is COMPLETE only when a matchup dossier contains attributable evidence across the required football dimensions or explicitly documents why a dimension is unavailable, plus market/model reconciliation and invalidators.

evidenceBackedCompleteGames.reason: High-priority market reset plus matchup/expert evidence and explicit execution hold.
Material starting-QB change plus market and matchup repricing evidence.
Longshot research includes price path, QB/upset mechanism, personnel and execution constraints.
Longshot research plus QB/personnel context and new Alabama availability evidence.
Premium matchup with market state and multiple attributable expert/trench/QB-pressure mechanisms.

pendingPolicy: The remaining 81 games remain PENDING until dossier evidence is written. They must not inherit COMPLETE from schedule hydration or a blanket weekly checkpoint.
executionLimitations: Exact executable book/juice and verified moneyline are not available for every matchup.
Podcast/source completeness remains independently governed; a game can have a complete football dossier while a newly published episode is still PROVISIONAL, and vice versa.

qc.priorIssue: Week 2 schedule/checkpoint coverage was incorrectly represented as 86/86 complete Deep Dives.
qc.resolution: Canonical status reset to evidence-backed completion only; schedule coverage and research completion are separated.
